crossRefs.note: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from those who desire an occasion, that in which they boast…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
Then don’t let your good be slandered,
When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
Abstain from every form of evil.

translations.web: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
translations.bsb: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
translations.kjv: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
translations.asv: Avoiding this, that any man should blame us in the matter of this bounty which is ministered by us:
